notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Update #02
notes.notes: For Update #02, we have now enabled Pause/Resume Functionality and fixed a few more bugs. We also did some performance optimizations.

notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Update #01
notes.notes:
For Update #01, we have added a bunch of new Steam Achievements. We have also tried to fix as many game breaking bugs as we could find. 

We have also decided to re-enable the Demo for Filmmaker Tycoon so people can try out the game before purchasing it.

notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Early Access Release Delayed to Nov 13, 2020
notes.notes:
Hey there future Filmmakers! We wanted you to be the first to know that we have decided to push Early Access Release by a week. The new release date is now on November 13, 2020. 

As you will soon find out in your Movies, the launch window is crucial to the success of the game. This extra week will give us a little more time to share the game to cultivate the best experience possible for you! After launch, this will also allow us to dedicate more resources to improving the game and implementing user suggestions for the main release! During this extra time we will be releasing fun videos and let's plays on YouTube. Be sure to check them out!

Thank you for understanding and supporting our team! Get those cameras ready...We'll see you on the 13th!

notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
The time has finally come! Filmmaker Tycoon is ready for Early Access Release. We are launching in Early Access on Nov 6, 2020. 

[h1]What's NEW?[/h1]
During the demo, we wanted to show off a taste of Filmmaker Tycoon. A lot of features were disabled and we showed off a barebones version of the game. The Early Access release will have more features - Cameramen, Lighting Crew, Audio Crew, Disasters, Post Production, Marketing and more!

[h1]Studio Lot Decor[/h1]
The success of your Movie Studio will depend on how well its maintained. You will be able to decorate your studio with trees, bushes, benches, vending machines, tiles and other amenities. The better your studio looks, the more attractive it will be for bigger stars to come work for you.

[h1]Movies, Movie Sets and Action![/h1]
Make movies across 14 different Movie Sets in a variety of different genres. You can mix and match actors, costumes, crew and more! Your every decision will reflect in the final movie, so choose wisely.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/778010/][h1]Wishlist Now[/h1]
Wishlist the game now and we will see you on Nov 6, 2020![/url]

notes.title: Filmmaker Tycoon Demo Launch
notes.notes:
The Demo for FILMMAKER TYCOON gives you a taste of what you can experience while you cultivate your very own Movie Studio!
Begin designing the Movie Studio of your dreams. Construct a Scriptwriting Office, a selection of Movie Sets, and more...

[h3]Produce your own Movies![/h3]
Cultivate your own experience by making the Movies the way YOU want... or the way your wallet will allow.

[h3]Manage your Employees![/h3]
Populate your Studio with Actors, Directors, Screenwriters, and other Staff to create Award Winning Movies! Each character in Filmmaker Tycoon is unique and has their own traits and behaviors.

[h3]Costuming[/h3]
Choose each and every part of your actors' costumes. Decide on what each character wears when they appear on the silver screen.

Filmmaker Tycoon lets you actually watch your film creations. Each movie you create is fully animated with voice acting and reflects every decision you made in the production of the film.
Shoot for the stars and get a taste of the Movie Making experience in the FILMMAKER TYCOON Demo!

notes.title: New Trailer and Early Access Announcement
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce our new trailer: Filmmaker Tycoon – Awards Trailer. It tells us what it takes to be a successful filmmaker. Create award winning movies, hire the best actors, customize their costumes, mess around with post-production and build the movie studio of your dreams in Filmmaker Tycoon! 

[previewyoutube=fS9nI0gu3-M;full][/previewyoutube]

Due to community interest, we have decided to launch the game on Steam Early Access in April 2020. The exact date will be announced shortly. 

The Early Access version of the game will feature a complete sandbox film-making experience. You, as the player, will be able to experience what it feels like to run a movie studio.

Over the course of Early Access, we plan to introduce a bunch of exciting game-play features and mechanics which are not fully polished yet for Early Access release. Some of those features include: Dynamic Poster Generation, Custom Movie Set Creation and Custom Actor Creation. While we are not 100% committing to when these features will be released, we can tell you that these features are in the works. 

We will also use Early Access as a platform to polish the features and game play mechanics we have already implemented.
